'''MichCon Jamestown Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60205|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is located in Michigan.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60205|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''MichCon<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60205|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''16.3 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60205|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60205|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60205|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2008
*'''Cost: '''US$70,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.naturalgasintel.com/?p=60205|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
